headline: Moved Hispanic Heritage Month proclamation forward for possible reading at the September 15 City Council meeting.
summary: The group voted unanimously to move a Hispanic Heritage Month proclamation forward for the Mayor to consider reading at the September 15 City Council meeting. It also voted unanimously to postpone a vote on the August 10, 2026 meeting minutes until the next regularly-scheduled meeting.
decisions: Moved the Hispanic Heritage Month proclamation forward for the Mayor to consider reading at the September 15 City Council meeting, unanimously.
Postponed the vote on the August 10, 2026 meeting minutes to the next regularly-scheduled meeting, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Jamie, seconded by Lauren, to move the proclamation forward for the Mayor to consider reading at the September 15 City Council meeting. Vote: Unanimous.
Motion by Jamie, seconded by David, to vote on the August meeting minutes at the next regularly-scheduled meeting. Vote: Unanimous.

plain_text:
September 1, 2026  
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Committee Meeting Minutes 
Present: David, Lauren, and Danica (in person); Flo, Anne, Aiden, and Jamie (participating 
via Microsoft Teams) 
Excused: Breese, Syed, Ariane 
 
1. Call to Order 
The meeting was called to order at 11:55 AM. 
 
2. Approval of Minutes 
2.a. August 10, 2026 Meeting Minutes 
Motion by Jamie, seconded by David, to vote on the August meeting minutes at the 
next regularly-scheduled meeting. 
Vote: Unanimous. 
 
3. Discussion Items 
3.a Hispanic Heritage Month Proclamation 
Motion by Jamie, seconded by Lauren, to move the proclamation forward for the 
Mayor to consider reading at the September 15 City Council meeting. 
Vote: Unanimous. 
 
4. Adjourn 
The meeting was adjourned by the Chair at 12 PM.
